column3: if · My Friend Akagi Chapter
The day after we safely returned from the school trip
While the feeling of the trip hadn't completely faded yet, the classes that day were flawlessly handled.
And then after school finished...
Hey, Kousaka. You're free during summer break, right?
At least ask "Do you have any plans?"
Huh? Then you've made plans with Tamura-san?
Right? Then it's fine, so accompany me for a little while.
Accompany you... to what?
I'm not asking you anything like going to pick up women at the pool or at a fireworks display!
I didn't ask any of that. Rather, you really seem to have thought that out a bit.
Hah! You're so stupid, Kousaka-kun. As if a good-looking guy like me would be infatuated with women!
Can I hit you?
Kousaka. You should only raise your fist when it's for the woman that's important to you.
Based on just that line, you are without a doubt an excellent man.
So? What do you want with me?
How kind of you to ask, my heartfelt friend!
The place I'm going is...
The Tokyo Big Sight......!!
What's wrong, Kousaka? You keep sighing.
Why am I participating in Summer Comiket in the middle of this damn heat, with a bastard like you?
......Because I invited you?
Well, that's true.
Anyway, let's hurry up and go inside. I'm drying up in this heat out here...
My thoughts exactly. I'd rather not get sun-dried along with you either.
Uheh... It's steaming in here...
It's actually hotter here than outside due to the packed dense crowd of warm bodies...
But... even so.
Isn't the percentage of females rather high where we're heading?
What are you saying, Kousaka? There's no distinction between men and women in this world, right?
Men love women, women love men... That's the recycle of life.
It's cycle, cycle. Don't mix it up with recycle.
Hmph! Anyway!
The place where we're heading is the zone for women separated from those ethics and morals.
......For women?
Well, even if I say for women, there are various things for young girls as well, but what we're aiming for is the spot for fujoshi--in other words, BL.
By the way, "BL" isn't an abbreviation for bacon lettuce, you know? It stands for romance between men, Boy's Love.
...Thank you for giving me the most unnecessary explanation in my life.
Sure! You're welcome!
Akagi gave a dazzling smile as he said that.
In return, I gave a bitter smile.
Don't make such a weary face.
Hey, think carefully. What is our gender?
Male!
Well done. Then, here's a problem. If two close male friends plunged into a crowd of females in order to buy BL goods...
Now then, what will happen?
Well, naturally...
They'll end up as the victims of the delusions of fujoshi!
Shall we go home immediately?
We can't, Kousaka. Even for me, it's so painful that I want to commit suicide, you know?
That much?! It pains you that much?! Then why did you come here?!
It can't be helped, you know? My cute little sister asked me to "Do it no matter what!" after all.
You'll listen to what your sister says no matter what it is?!
Well, if she goes as far as to "no matter what", yeah.
Right, you're refreshingly disgusting.
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!
You say that when you don't even know my little sister! It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that my little sister is the last angel that descended to this
world!
If she were a real angel, she wouldn't get her older brother to buy her BL goods.
Hey, Kousaka, do you know?
Real angels don't grow wings.
Incredible. You're seriously the model of a trained older brother.
I knew this guy was a siscon that adored his sister, but I didn't think he was this hardcore.
I definitely don't want to follow his example, though.
Hey, I'm begging you, Kousaka. Think of it as putting me in your debt, and accompany me to the very end!
I get, I get it. I also wouldn't want to be abandoned alone in a place like this.
Was it my imagination, or were the gazes of the girls that had been looking at us since earlier heating up in a disturbing way?
How to put it? Their eyes were like those of raptors directed at their prey...
I don't feel confident that I can get home alive if I stray and get lost here...
Kousaka, watch out!
Eh?! Uooh?!!
Idiot! Look properly where you're walking!
There's a violent flow of people around here because of queue servicing or something.
M-My bad. I was caught up in my thoughts...
...Geez. That's the kind of guy you are. You're no good without me around.
While speaking curtly, Akagi peered at me with a worried expression.
It really is important to have a close friend.
He's way more reliable than his brutal little sister, and is the best friend I could have.
I was saved thanks to you. Thank yo--
Hey, is that...
Yeah. It's definitely that, right?
Hearing those female voices from somewhere, all my bodily functions temporarily stopped.
What's wrong? You suddenly became stiff.
...I can feel gazes directed at us.
Aren't you just overly self-conscious?
Of course not.
My ears had definitely caught it.
Girls were talking about us...no, that wasn't all.
The females surrounding us were looking at us intermittently, and I could tell that they were using us as victims of their terrible delusions.
Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Uoh, what was that?!
This is bad, this is bad, Akagi...
At this rate, we're going to end up as food for the raptors...!
Akagi, let's leave for a bit. I have a bad feeling.
Y-Yeah...
I don't know if Akagi understood what was going on, but he seemed to have sensed danger.
We locked eyes and nodded.
And then, Akagi's hand firmly grasped my own...
Let's go, Kousaka!
I could feel Akagi's strong determination through his hand.
We pushed through the crowd and tried to escape.
However, the surrounding Comiket participants, as if anticipating something, nonchalantly blocked our way.
Kuh! S-Sorry! P-Passing through!
Kousaka, don't get crushed!
Yeah... Waah!
Kousaka!!
...Sorry, Akagi.
As if to trample on Akagi's determination, I was sucked into the center of this stifling melting pot of a crowd.
Kousaka! Kousaka! Kousaka...!!!!!
...I head Akagi's voice several times through a thin membrane.
A violent pressure weighed down on my body, and I couldn't even breathe.
I have to respond to Akagi's shout. I have to reply back.
However, I collapsed to the floor of the Comiket hall building while desperately opening my mouth like a suffocating goldfish.
...I heard Akagi's voice several times through a thin membrane.
A violent pressure weighed down on my body, and I couldn't even breathe.
I have to respond to Akagi's shout. I have to reply back.
However, I was about to collapse to the floor of the Comiket hall building while desperately opening my mouth like a suffocating goldfish--
Kousaka, grab on!
...Just before I lost consciousness, Akagi's hand grabbed me.
After that, he somehow managed to drag me out into an open space.
Haa... haa... haa... Y-You saved me...!
What were you doing, Kousaka?
Sorry... Akagi.
Sinking down to the floor, I gazed at the waves of people around us.
This... was bad.
I couldn't see a single gap between the uninterrupted flow of raptors.
Akagi, I'll wait here, so you can go ahead--
All right, let's go retake the challenge!
No, I'm already...
What are you saying? Come on!
Akagi forcibly made me stand up.
I was then dragged into the human sea once again...!
Oh my, what a big catch!
Thanks to you, Kousaka, we were able to go to all the checked circles. With this, my little sister should revise her opinion of me!
Thank you, Kousaka!
Huh? Kousaka? What's wrong with you? Have you lost weight?
I'm worn out! ...But I didn't have even a slight amount of the energy needed to say that.
Some time had passed since we had been swallowed up by that human sea earlier.
Although I had managed to get saved by Akagi and believed that we would escape at that point, Akagi had triumphantly resumed shopping around.
Actually, why did you receive no damage? Do you actually have an interest in 'that'?
The delusions that the fujoshi talked so explosively about... You aren't telling me that you didn't hear them, are you!?
Well, you know? It's like... I'm kind of used to it?
Used to it, you say... you've gotten used to that?
Well, yeah...
I have a little sister who does it a hundred times worse than that at home, after all.
I seriously respect you.
If I had that kind of little sister, I might kill myself.
That's how it is. Though I do feel gross after having sweat so much.
Yeah, me too.
I had worked up an unpleasant-feeling sweat due to more than just the heat.
I want to quickly take a bath and refresh myself... in both body and mind.
So, I have a proposal.
Ah? What is it?
How about we head to a public bath now?
Haaaaaaaaaaah...
Kuuuuuh! The hot water is sinking into my tired body...!
The hot summer makes you not want to take a bath? What nonsense!
Because summer is hot, you submerge yourself in hot water and blow off your sweat, enjoying the summer. That is to say, this is the ultimate
pleasure!
Similarly eating ramen during midsummer is also stylish.
Moreover, we have it reserved for ourselves! This is the best!
Ah... Hurrah for the Japanese...!
Buh. You sound like an old man.
Aah?
Whose fault do you think it is that I'm this tired?
Yeah, yeah. It's my fault.
Here, I'll give you a massage as recompense.
Nuah?! W-What are you doing all of a sudden?
Now, now! I'm actually good at this kind of thing.
Akagi cheerfully massaged my body.
His skill at it wasn't bad.
If he's wavering over whether to got to university or get a job in the future, he should open a massage pallor.
Even so.
Hmm, what?
It would've been nice if we 【explored the inn】 we stayed at during the school trip. That's my only regret.
What's with that?
But doesn't that kind of thing get your heart racing?
It would've been nice if we made lifelong memories like peeking into the girls' bath or the girls' bedrooms. Right?
Yeah, yeah, you go ahead and do that.
Well, being able to socialize with you naked like this isn't that bad either... There we go!
Ooooooooooooooh...!
Fuu... how's that?
Ah, it's paradise! Thank you.
Ah... I might be getting dizzy.
Sorry. I'm getting out first.
Yeah... I'll soak here a little longer.
Make sure not to overdo it, old man.
Hah, right back at you.
Oomph... Ah...
Without time to stop, Akagi stood up in front of me...
And, somewhat conveniently, he started acting light-headed.
Akagi, Akagi?! Are you all right, Akagi......!!
Sorry, Kousaka... I'm feeling really dizzy...
Just wait, 'll bring you somewhere cool right away...
No... it's fine.
Huh?! What are you saying?!
You... have to get out of here quickly... if not, you'll end up like me...
You idiot! As if I could leave you behind!
...Kousaka.
Come on, lend me your shoulder.
I supported Akagi's body and stood him up.
His body was hot like lava.
...Sorry.
If you have the energy to speak, then you're okay.
...Haha.
As I lifted up my foot to get out of the bath...
...My leg slipped, plunging me into the bath.
I tried to get up immediately, but I couldn't stand up well while supporting Akagi's body.
...This is bad! Wait, Akagi?!
The scene that barely entered my field of view was that of Akagi having fainted and completely lost consciousness.
*glub, glub, glub, glub, glub*
I desperately called out to get Akagi's attention.
But I was in the bath, so only water of 42 degrees temperature entered my mouth.
While feeling Akagi's weight with my entire body, my mind went blank...!
...After that, I was somehow rescued by the bath attendant.
If he hadn't noticed... who knows what would have happened...
...I'm alive... I'm alive...!
Hah, hah... thank goodness, Kousaka.
After we were allowed to rest for a while, we bought ourselves coffee milk in place of gratitude.
Even though I took a bath, I feel even more tired.
Afterwards, Akagi seemed to have somewhere else he wanted to visit, but I decided to decline and head home.
I felt as exhausted as I could possibly be.
I felt like I just barely had the strength to stand. If this were a game, my HP would be in the yellow zone, and my MP would be completely empty.
Hey, Kousaka...
I refuse.
Why?! I still haven't said anything yet!
Based on the pattern up till now, I can roughly tell that it's nothing good.
Don't say that. I just want to thank you for all the trouble you went through with me today.
......What's with that?
Akagi was looking at me with an unusually serious face.
Whether because my heart wasn't honest or I felt some kind of ulterior motive from Akagi, I really couldn't accept his words upfront.
Thanks... for today.
Yeah, yeah. You owe me big for this.
Don't say that. I'm grateful. Seriously.
...That's gross.
If you hadn't come along, I would have drowned in that human sea at Comiket and later at the bath too.
You just keep triggering drowning flags.
Haha. That's true. But...
Hmm?
It's thanks to you that I was able to return alive from that abyss of death.
...Kousaka, thank you.
Y-Yeah... wait, wasn't it for your little sister? We went through quite some misfortune because of that...
What are you saying? We didn't go through that much misfortune.
Yeah, yeah. There's a extreme siscon here.
You also have a little sister, don't you? Don't you understand my feelings?
I don't understand it at all!
Suppose all of today's difficulties were for Kirino's sake?
...Just thinking about it seemed to suddenly increase my exhaustion.
Why does Akagi think his own little sister was so cute?
I didn't understand it at all.
But, well... It wasn't bad hanging together with just the two of us.
Well, isn't it nice every once in a while? Going out somewhere with you.
Eh, is that so?
Just every once in a while, every once in a while.
Then, for the doujin event at Ikebukuro this autumn...
I refuse.
Even though you just said that you like accompanying me...
Just every once in a while, every once in a while! As if I could bear going with you all the time!
Even though you say that, you actually want to go, don't you?
N-Not really...
Hiding your embarrassment like that; maybe this time you'll be the one swallowed.
Are you trying to say something clever?!
Kinda. Anyway, I'm counting on you.
I refuse.
Don't say that.
Rejected!!
Kousaka-sa～n.
You're being gross!
Geez, you're really not honest.
The way Akagi desperately begged me made me feel both disgusted, and strangely at ease.
Well... What I said to him earlier wasn't a lie.
...It's not so bad, going out like this together with the two of us every once in a while.
......You guys really get along well, Onii-chan and Kousaka-senpai......
Ah, Sena-chan! When did you get here?
Since the two of you left the bath with a good mood going between you! Fufufu... fufufufufufufu...
S-Stop it... What you're thinking of right now is a huge misunderstanding!
Kousaka, let me introduce her! This is my little sister, the cutest angel in the world, Sena-chan!
I already know her. We're in the Game Research Club together.
I didn't bother to try retorting to that declaration of "the cutest angel in the world, Sena-chan".
I know very well how you're an unrivalled little sister-loving idiot.
Kousaka-senpai, you haven't come to the Game Research Club recently, have you? Please come over every once in a while.
Yeah, yeah, I get it.
Then, we should be getting back soon. Sorry, but I'll be borrowing Onii-chan.
There's no need to apologize. Hurry up and take him.
There you go again～～. Even though you're lovers～～
That's wrong!
As if that could be!
Geez... I immediately take back what I said just now.
--It's not so bad, going out like this together with the two of us every one in a while.--
That's something that mustn't be said in the presence of this fujoshi little sister!
Then, see you again! At the club room!
